name: week
title: Network address review
subtitle: A snapshot of recorded inventory. No live discovery.

sections.title: Capacity
sections.sql: select namespace,name,subnet,used_percent,trunc(available)::text as available from capacity_review where status<>'deprecated' order by namespace,subnet

sections.title: Decisions due
sections.sql: select code,namespace,name,address,requester,due,attention from change_review order by due

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select entity,record,owner,review_due from review_queue order by review_due nulls first

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,entity,record,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,record

sections.title: Reserved addresses
sections.sql: select namespace,name,address::text,subnet,owner,review_due from address_register where status='reserved' order by namespace,address

sections.title: Open follow-ups
sections.sql: select n.name as namespace,a.title,a.owner,a.due from actions a join namespaces n on n.id=a.namespace_id where a.status='open' order by a.due
